style="rounded=1;arcSize=10;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#eff6ff;strokeColor=#93c5fd;strokeWidth=1;fontFamily=Helvetica;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" value="<div style="font-size: 11px; font-weight: bold; letter-spacing: 0.5px; color: #1e40af;">PILLAR 1: STEP EXECUTION</div><div style="font-size: 13px; font-weight: bold; color: #0f172a; margin-top: 2px;">Unified Saga Execution Patterns (USEP)</div><div style="font-size: 10px; color: #64748b;">Step Execution &amp; Commit Timing</div>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="52" width="310" x="65" y="195" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="u-p1-i1" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#cbd5e1;strokeWidth=1;fontFamily=Helvetica;align=left;spacingLeft=10;verticalAlign=middle;" value="<b style="color: #0f172a; font-size: 11px;">1. Direct Synchronous</b> <span style="color: #2563eb; font-size: 10px;">(Sync-Continuous)</span><div style="font-size: 10px; color: #64748b; margin-top: 1px;">Inline in-thread request/response • Lowest latency</div>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="42" width="310" x="65" y="257" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="u-p1-i2" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#cbd5e1;strokeWidth=1;fontFamily=Helvetica;align=left;spacingLeft=10;verticalAlign=middle;" value="<b style="color: #0f172a; font-size: 11px;">2. Correlated Park-and-Resume</b> <span style="color: #2563eb; font-size: 10px;">(Sync-Paused)</span><div style="font-size: 10px; color: #64748b; margin-top: 1px;">"Park and Wait" liberates threads • Webhook / UI / Kafka</div>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="42" width="310" x="65" y="307" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="u-p1-i3" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#cbd5e1;strokeWidth=1;fontFamily=Helvetica;align=left;spacingLeft=10;verticalAlign=middle;" value="<b style="color: #0f172a; font-size: 11px;">3. Two-Stage Lazy Dispatch</b> <span style="color: #2563eb; font-size: 10px;">(Async-Paused)</span><div style="font-size: 10px; color: #64748b; margin-top: 1px;">Commit Barrier • Absolute immunity to race conditions</div>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="42" width="310" x="65" y="357" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="u-p1-dest" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f1f5f9;strokeColor=none;fontFamily=Helvetica;verticalAlign=middle;" value="<div style="font-size: 10px; color: #475569; text-align: center;">Concludes at <b style="color: #0f172a;">[Destination]</b> ➔ Hands off control to USNP</div>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="28" width="310" x="65" y="407" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="u-p2-box" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#7c3aed;strokeWidth=1.5;fontFamily=Helvetica;" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="270" width="330" x="465" y="185" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="u-p2-hdr" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=10;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f3ff;strokeColor=#c4b5fd;strokeWidth=1;fontFamily=Helvetica;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" value="<div style="font-size: 11px; font-weight: bold; letter-spacing: 0.5px; color: #6b21a8;">PILLAR 2: WORKFLOW NAVIGATION</div><div style="font-size: 13px; font-weight: bold; color: #0f172a; margin-top: 2px;">Unified Saga Navigation Patterns (USNP)</div><div style="font-size: 10px; color: #64748b;">Workflow Graph Routing &amp; Compensation</div>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="52" width="310" x="475" y="195" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="u-p2-i1" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#cbd5e1;strokeWidth=1;fontFamily=Helvetica;align=left;spacingLeft=10;verticalAlign=middle;" value="<b style="color: #0f172a; font-size: 11px;">1. Forward Active &amp; Dynamic Branching</b><div style="font-size: 10px; color: #64748b; margin-top: 1px;">ProcessStepManager • Command ➔ Command / Query</div>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="38" width="310" x="475" y="253" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="u-p2-i2" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#cbd5e1;strokeWidth=1;fontFamily=Helvetica;align=left;spacingLeft=10;verticalAlign=middle;" value="<b style="color: #0f172a; font-size: 11px;">2. Deterministic Reverse Autopilot</b><div style="font-size: 10px; color: #64748b; margin-top: 1px;">RevertStepManager • Zero manual rollback routing (LIFO)</div>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="38" width="310" x="475" y="297" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="u-p2-i3" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#cbd5e1;strokeWidth=1;fontFamily=Helvetica;align=left;spacingLeft=10;verticalAlign=middle;" value="<b style="color: #0f172a; font-size: 11px;">3. 3-Phase Compensation Pipeline</b><div style="font-size: 10px; color: #64748b; margin-top: 1px;">PreExecutor ➔ Core doRevert() ➔ PostExecutor</div>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="38" width="310" x="475" y="341" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="u-p2-i4" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#cbd5e1;strokeWidth=1;fontFamily=Helvetica;align=left;spacingLeft=10;verticalAlign=middle;" value="<b style="color: #0f172a; font-size: 11px;">4. Query State Pruning &amp; Bypass</b><div style="font-size: 10px; color: #64748b; margin-top: 1px;">QueryExecutor • Auto-skipped during compensation</div>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="38" width="310" x="475" y="385" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="u-p2-dest" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f1f5f9;strokeColor=none;fontFamily=Helvetica;verticalAlign=middle;" value="<div style="font-size: 10px; color: #475569; text-align: center;">Terminal: <b style="color: #0f172a;">.complete()</b> or reverse completion</div>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="20" width="310" x="475" y="427" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
